copied.note: Replaces the sum line under the amount for a moment after the amount is tapped and copied.

amountA11y.note: VoiceOver label of the big amount on the entry sheet; amount is formatted, with its sign.

noteA11y.note: VoiceOver label of the note line; note is what the user typed.

locationPinned.note: VoiceOver label: the entry has map coordinates but no place name.

placeSuggested.note: The place line when the category was filled in from what was logged here before. place is a shop name or coordinates.

entry.splitA11y: Split into {count, plural, one {# entry} other {# entries}}. Tap to edit.

splitThisEntry.note: Split summary line: the part that stays on the entry being edited when it has no category.

splitNoCategory.note: Split summary line: a part without a category. Lowercase, it follows an amount.

returnedLine.note: An entry part of which was paid back; both are formatted amounts.

entry.returnedA11y: {back} {currency} came back; paid {paid}. Tap to forget the returns.

photoUnsaved.note: A photo was just taken and is kept only when the entry is saved.

accountA11y.note: VoiceOver label of the account pill.

accountNone.note: Fills {name} in "Account: {name}" when there is no account.

balance.note: Small pill next to the account that unfolds the balance before and after this entry.

pending.note: Toggle chip: keep this entry in the Pending queue.

split.note: Chip that splits the entry into parts with their own categories.

return.note: Chip: the amount typed is money that came back on an earlier expense.

receipt.note: Chip that opens the receipt scanner.

title.note: currency is a code like USD.

receiptCurrency.body: No exchange rate available offline; the number was kept as is.

body.note: Asked after picking an account in another currency. account is the account's name; from/to are currency codes.

splitNeedsTotal.title: Type the total first
splitNeedsTotal.body: A split shares out the amount on the entry, so there has to be one.

returnPickTitle.note: Title of the picker that chooses which earlier entry a return belongs to.

entry.returnPickDesc: You paid, and {amount} {currency} came back. Choose the entry it belongs to and it shrinks by that much — no new transaction is added.
entry.returnCannot: That entry cannot take this return

returnThatEntry.note: Stands in for an entry's name when it has neither a note nor a payee.

returnReason.transfer: A transfer moves money between your own accounts, so there is nothing to come back from.
returnReason.tooMuch: That is more than is left on the entry. Book the rest against another one, or edit it by hand.
returnReason.wrongDirection: Money can only come back the other way round from how it went out.
returnReason.gone: The entry is no longer there.

forgetReturns.title: Forget the returns?
forgetReturns.body: {amount} {currency} goes back on the entry, as if nothing had come back.

unsaved.title: Add this transaction?
unsaved.incomplete: The amount is not complete yet.

body.message: {summary} opens as a new entry. Nothing is added until you confirm it.
body.note: summary is the amount with its currency and, if any, the category: "−4.50 EUR · Coffee".

makeTransfer.title: Make this a transfer?
makeTransfer.moved: {amount} {currency} will be moved to the transfer.

convert.message: This entry becomes one side of the transfer and keeps its note, place and photo. Choose the other account next.
convert.note: Turning a saved expense or income into a transfer.

title.note: Header of the preview shown before several transactions are changed at once.

bulk.count: {count, plural, one {# transaction changes} other {# transactions change}}

skippedConfirmed.note: Follows the count of changes after " · ".

skippedSame.note: Follows the count of changes after " · ": rows that already have this value.

transfers.message: {count, plural, one {both sides of a transfer} other {both sides of # transfers}}
transfers.note: Follows the count of changes after " · ".

bulk.empty: Nothing to change: every one of them already says that.

split.title: Split the entry
split.intro: One shop, several things. Give each part its own category — what is left stays on the entry itself.
split.chooseRestCategory: Choose a category for the rest

rest.note: Small caption under the amount that stays on the entry itself.

partA11y.note: n is the part's number (2, 3…); category is its name or "no category".

split.ready: {count, plural, one {# entry will be added} other {# entries will be added}}, all with the same date, note, place and photo.

howMuch.note: Title over the calculator that sets one part's amount.

hint.addPart: Add a part to split this entry
hint.tooMuch: The parts come to more than the entry
